IN PHOTOS: Members of the Ateneo community marched towards Ateneo Gate 2.5 from the Zen Garden for a candle-lighting ceremony and prayer vigil in commemoration of the 40th anniversary of the People Power Revolution. Attendees also participated in a noise barrage to protest against ongoing corruption issues and to reaffirm the Ateneo community’s commitment to truth and justice.

The event was organized by the Ateneo Martial Law Museum and Library, together with the Sanggunian, Council of Organizations of the Ateneo - Manila, The Ateneo Assembly, and the Ateneo Student Catholic Action.

Photos by Jio Japson and Joseph Castillo

data.raw_text:
GM ☀️ The Quiet Rise of the Hypergraph ($DAG): From Pioneer to AI Powerhouse

Constellation Networks Hypergraph Transfer Protocol (HGTP) is a Layer-0 DAG built since 2017 for verifiable data, infinite scale, & ironclad security. It fixes blockchain bottlenecks with parallel transactions, no blocks, & feeless high-throughput for big data, sensors, & AI inputs.

Core tech: Proof of Reputable Observation (PRO) consensus uses reputation scores & ML for efficient, adaptive networks. It benchmarks 80000+ TPS, supports custom metagraphs (application-specific L1 chains) for precise validation without oracles, & is JVM-compatible for easy enterprise integration. $DAG fuels bandwidth & access, gas-free.

Strategic focus: Federal adoption over hype. DoD partnerships from 2019, USAF SBIR 2021 (validated secure/scalable/DoD-approved), backed by SecDef, USTRANSCOM, & more. Iron SPIDR program integrates partners like Kinnami, SIMBA Chain, Panasonic, Forward Edge-AI for tamper-proof data orchestration.

Powerhouse moves: Dor Technologies acquisition (2021) adds IoT revenue via Dor Traffic Miners for clients like Snowflake/Foursquare. Mainnet 2.0 (2022) brings metagraphs, Metanomics (Hacken AA-audited, low inflation to 0.5%, 300+ global nodes). Top federal blockchain awardee, zero missed milestones in 6+ years, CSIAC nods, Army War College praise for human-machine integration.

Global push: DeRec Alliance (Hedera, Algorand, Ripple, XRPL), Digital Chamber membership, NSF DigiFoundry DAO backbone (FAA, NASA, Treasury, Space Force, Microsoft, Dell, & IBM). CEO Ben Jorgensen keynoted on trillion-dollar transparency economy.

Real breakthroughs: Philippines lottery (M42/DFNN), world’s first AI-blockchain-crypto system (late 2025). Digital Evidence (Q1 2025) for tamper-proof AI/mobility/assets, integrated by LabsDAO, OB Collective (UK gov), JADO. Panasonic Toughbook metagraph, TEMTRACE forensic compliance. Common Crawl for AI provenance (80%+ LLMs).

Interoperability: $DAG on Kraken (INK bridge, first non-native), Base DeFi (Aerodrome). MiCAR-compliant, PacaSwap DEX, delegated staking, & open tools. Metagraphs (Real Estate Ledger, UpsiderAI, & Bundle It) drive revenue; delegate to Dor/Upsider for multi-token rewards.

Paying customers: DoD/USTRANSCOM primary, Philippines Charity Sweepstakes, Panasonic, M42, DFNN, Forward Edge-AI, real metagraph/validation revenue.

2026 position: Pending AI2 acquisition (Nasdaq-bound) injects up to $25M scaling, blending AI & blockchain. Focus: AI agent provenance, tamper-proof IoT/satellite streams (Army, retail, defense). Gartner: 35% countries region-specific AI by 2027, HGTPs sovereignty fits perfectly.

Team (CEO Ben Jorgensen, CTO Alex Brand, CSO Benjamin Diggles, Product Dir Joao Carvalho) ships strong. 

Community: Build > complain, delegate $DAG for rewards. From DAG trailblazer to AI verifier, substance wins. Undervalued dominance play. DYOR.
